objects.name: asset_master_current
objects.description: Current canonical asset view derived from asset_master_history.
objects.view_definition: CREATE VIEW asset_master_current AS SELECT * EXCLUDE (_row_rank) FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY universal_asset_id ORDER BY _imported_at_utc DESC, last_updated_at_utc DESC) AS _row_rank FROM asset_master_history) WHERE (_row_rank = 1);

objects.name: asset_master_history
objects.description: Append-only canonical history of assets published by source domains. Each row represents an observed asset record for a platform run.

objects.name: forecasts_current
objects.description: Current forecast view derived from forecasts_history.
objects.view_definition: CREATE VIEW forecasts_current AS SELECT * EXCLUDE (_row_rank) FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY universal_asset_id, forecast_horizon_months, forecast_method ORDER BY _imported_at_utc DESC, generated_at_utc DESC) AS _row_rank FROM forecasts_history) WHERE (_row_rank = 1);

objects.name: forecasts_history
objects.description: Append-only history of source and UIP forecast observations.

objects.name: macro_signals_current
objects.description: Current macro-signal view.
objects.view_definition: CREATE VIEW macro_signals_current AS SELECT * EXCLUDE (_row_rank) FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY signal_id ORDER BY _imported_at_utc DESC, generated_at_utc DESC) AS _row_rank FROM macro_signals_history) WHERE (_row_rank = 1);

objects.name: macro_signals_history
objects.description: Append-only history of canonical macroeconomic or market signals.

objects.name: platform_status_current
objects.description: Current platform-status view.
objects.view_definition: CREATE VIEW platform_status_current AS SELECT * EXCLUDE (_row_rank) FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY platform_id ORDER BY _imported_at_utc DESC, generated_at_utc DESC) AS _row_rank FROM platform_status_history) WHERE (_row_rank = 1);

objects.name: platform_status_history
objects.description: Append-only history of source-platform publication and run status.

objects.name: portfolio_positions_current
objects.description: Current canonical portfolio-position view.
objects.view_definition: CREATE VIEW portfolio_positions_current AS SELECT * EXCLUDE (_row_rank) FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY platform_id, account_id, universal_asset_id ORDER BY _imported_at_utc DESC, last_updated_at_utc DESC) AS _row_rank FROM portfolio_positions_history) WHERE (_row_rank = 1);

objects.name: portfolio_positions_history
objects.description: Append-only history of canonical portfolio positions imported or derived for a platform run.

objects.name: recommendations_current
objects.description: Current recommendation view derived from recommendations_history.
objects.view_definition: CREATE VIEW recommendations_current AS SELECT * EXCLUDE (_row_rank) FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY universal_asset_id ORDER BY _imported_at_utc DESC, generated_at_utc DESC) AS _row_rank FROM recommendations_history) WHERE (_row_rank = 1);

objects.name: recommendations_history
objects.description: Append-only history of recommendations and recommendation evidence.

objects.name: risk_metrics_current
objects.description: Current risk-metric view derived from risk_metrics_history.
objects.view_definition: CREATE VIEW risk_metrics_current AS SELECT * EXCLUDE (_row_rank) FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY universal_asset_id ORDER BY _imported_at_utc DESC, generated_at_utc DESC) AS _row_rank FROM risk_metrics_history) WHERE (_row_rank = 1);

objects.name: risk_metrics_history
objects.description: Append-only history of asset-level risk measurements.

objects.name: universal_import_datasets
objects.description: Dataset-level evidence for universal import attempts.

objects.name: universal_import_error_summary
objects.description: Aggregated current import-error summary.
objects.view_definition: CREATE VIEW universal_import_error_summary AS SELECT import_id, severity, error_code, count_star() AS occurrence_count, min(created_at_utc) AS first_seen_at_utc, max(created_at_utc) AS last_seen_at_utc FROM universal_import_errors GROUP BY import_id, severity, error_code;

objects.name: universal_import_errors
objects.description: Detailed import-validation and activation errors.

objects.name: universal_import_health
objects.description: Current import-health view by source platform.
objects.view_definition: CREATE VIEW universal_import_health AS SELECT r.platform_id, r.platform_name, r.platform_version, r.adapter_version, r.contract_version, r.registry_status, r.last_package_id, r.last_run_id, r.last_import_id, r.last_import_status, r.last_imported_at_utc, r.last_data_as_of_date, r.total_successful_imports, r.total_failed_imports, r.total_rows_imported, r.warning_count, r.error_count, r.status_message, CASE  WHEN (((r.registry_status = 'ACTIVE') AND (r.last_import_status = 'IMPORTED'))) THEN ('HEALTHY') WHEN ((r.last_import_status IN ('FAILED', 'REJECTED'))) THEN ('DEGRADED') WHEN ((r.last_import_status IS NULL)) THEN ('NOT_IMPORTED') ELSE 'WARNING' END AS health_status FROM universal_platform_registry AS r;

objects.name: universal_imports
objects.description: Import-attempt registry containing package, platform, timing, and outcome evidence.

objects.name: universal_latest_import_attempt
objects.description: Latest import attempt per platform.
objects.view_definition: CREATE VIEW universal_latest_import_attempt AS SELECT * EXCLUDE (_row_rank) FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY platform_id ORDER BY started_at_utc DESC NULLS LAST, discovered_at_utc DESC NULLS LAST) AS _row_rank FROM universal_imports) WHERE (_row_rank = 1);

objects.name: universal_latest_successful_import
objects.description: Latest successfully activated import per platform.
objects.view_definition: CREATE VIEW universal_latest_successful_import AS SELECT * EXCLUDE (_row_rank) FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY platform_id ORDER BY completed_at_utc DESC NULLS LAST, started_at_utc DESC NULLS LAST) AS _row_rank FROM universal_imports WHERE (import_status = 'IMPORTED')) WHERE (_row_rank = 1);

objects.name: universal_packages
objects.description: Registry of received and validated universal delivery packages.

objects.name: universal_platform_registry
objects.description: Canonical registry of integrated source platforms.
